name: gamenet_get_local_player_color_index_or_zero
description: GameNet::GetLocalPlayerColorIndexOrZero returns the local net-player row color index, or zero when the local save state or row is absent.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a GameNet source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja's HLIL renders the zero return paths as pointer-typed temporaries, but the assembly returns integer zero in EAX.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4336f0 validates the read of g_GameStateOrMapTable, zero return when the local save state is null, saveState->netPlayerRow at offset 0x24, zero return when the row is null, and row->playerColorIndex at offset 0x04 as the success return.
The native smoke covers null local save state, null net-player row, and a present row returning color index 6.
